name: Trade Status 1
definition: Specifies the status of a trade in a central settlement system.

AllegedTrade.name: Alleged Trade
AllegedTrade.definition: Specifies whether a trade is alleged or not.

MatchingSystemUniqueReference.name: Matching System Unique Reference
MatchingSystemUniqueReference.definition: Reference to the unique identification assigned to a trade by a central matching system.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Specifies the status of a trade.

ExtendedStatus.name: Extended Status
ExtendedStatus.definition: Description of the status of a trade when no coded form is available.

StatusSubType.name: Status Sub Type
StatusSubType.definition: Additional information on the status of a trade in a central system.

StatusTime.name: Status Time
StatusTime.definition: Specifies the time at which a status was assigned.

StatusOriginator.name: Status Originator
StatusOriginator.definition: Identifies the party which assigned a status to a treasury trade.
